title: A filter on another table reaches the groups through the measure
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Color], TREATAS ( { "JP" }, Customer[Country] ), "Amt", [Sales Amount] )

source.quote: They do not apply to group-by columns from other tables directly, but indirectly through the implied non-empty filter from measures.
source.supports: the country filter changes the measure, and blank groups drop out

derivation: Only Cho is in JP: Sales rows 5 (Bike, Red, 200) and 6 (Lock, Blue, 30). Red 200, Blue 30; Green is BLANK and dropped.
